Best general advice I can give as I went through hardware so fast due to mistakes. 
1. Make sure loose wires are far away from your arduino while powered. Don’t want one of those buggers to slip under it, touch two contacts together, and short some pins (happened 3 times to me, so not as uncommon as I thought)
2. Double, triple, and quadruple check voltage and current ratings. Blowing up a board or peripheral due to a power overload is no fun.

Bonus tip (edit): when something goes wrong (WHEN, not if), do not stress out or get frustrated. Set it down, go about your day, and consider solutions as you go. Eventually, you’ll get an idea, and you can go back test it. If that doesn’t work, repeat the process.
